rows.36:9464:
She was sitting at her own desk, limp and drained.
Her face looked even paler than before.
I got worried and ran over to her, but Sanae just stayed slumped over her desk...
It looked like even lifting her head was too much effort...
"Reiko...?"
She spoke slowly.
"Yeah, it's me. Sanae, are you okay?"
"Yeah... I'm fiiine."
But she still had no energy at all, and her face seemed to be turning bluer and bluer.
"Hey, let's go back to the nurse's office."
That would definitely be better, right?
But for some reason, Sanae didn't want to go.
And then she said this, in a thin little voice:
"You're so kind, Reiko. Please stay my friend forever and ever."
...like that.
"Okay."
I found myself nodding before I knew it.{p}
rows.36:96cc: That's when Sanae finally lifted her head.{p}And around her mouth...!
rows.36:9754:
She had fangs!
Not some cute little snaggletooth, either, but thin, sharp fangs...
Sanae's face was bloodless and pure white, but her lips alone were unnaturally red.
I just kept staring at her face in a daze.
I must have already been under her spell...
Then I felt a little prick on the side of my neck.
When I snapped out of it, Sanae was biting into my neck!
Gulp.
I heard Sanae's throat swallow, and the strength drained out of my body.
So Sanae's a vampire...
That's what I was thinking while she sucked my blood.{p}
rows.36:9958: Hee hee, well, {c}{f:|}?{p}Do you believe my story?
rows.36:99c4:
Really, now?
If Sanae's a vampire, then wouldn't that make me a vampire too, since she sucked my blood?
How can you stay so calm?
Or are you interested in eternal life?
It is kind of romantic, isn't it?
An old coffin, hidden away in the cellar of an ancient castle in Europe.
And inside it, a vampire who rises every night to wander in search of blood...
And then there's a love story with a beautiful woman, right?
...Oh no, I'm getting off topic.{p}
rows.36:9b70:
Hee hee, but you believed me, didn't you?
So you're fine with me being a vampire.
Good, because I was just getting hungry.
{c}{f:|}, would you treat me to a meal?
I mean blood, of course.
Don't worry, I won't kill you.
You'll get a little sleepy, but that much is okay, right?
See, it was just a little prick, wasn't it?
It didn't hurt, did it?
Are you starting to feel sleepy?
When you wake up, everyone will be one of us.
Oh, but watch out for the morning sun.
You'll turn to ash.
So this is the end of our little gathering, huh?
It had only just started, too. What a shame.{p}
rows.36:9d78:
That's right.
Tiny human faces were crammed together in there.
And among them was a face I felt I'd seen somewhere...
Even if I'm not into idols, I do watch TV, so I at least know Ketsu's face.
He was pretty famous, after all.{p}
rows.36:9e4c:
"Ketsu is going to live on inside me from now on.
From now on, he'll sing just for me."
Sanae said it in a cheerful voice, but then she hung her head right away.
"It was the only way I could think of.
If I didn't do this, I couldn't save him!"
By the end, she was in tears.
"What's wrong, Sanae? I can't understand you if you're crying."
"...Okay. Well, at the concert yesterday..."{p}
rows.36:9fd8:
According to Sanae, there was an accident at the very end of the concert... during the encore.
Some worked-up, fanatical fans trampled the security guards and stormed the stage.
When the other fans saw that, they all rushed forward too, each trying to get there first, and the whole hall was total chaos!
Once it gets like that, nothing can stop it, right?
Most of them were young girls, so I guess it was a kind of mass hysteria.
Sanae's seat was on the second level.
So all she could do was watch from above, stunned.{p}
rows.36:a18c:
By the time someone hurried to turn the lights on, Ketsu had been crushed by his fans and was bleeding...
He'd already stopped breathing, and his pupils were dilated, she said.
Fans are scary, aren't they?
Not the fans themselves, but their feelings, I guess...
This goes for anyone, but people who get fixated on things swing from one extreme to the other.{p}
rows.36:a2cc:
...I'll go on with Sanae's story.
Sanae was so sad that Ketsu had died...
And since it happened so suddenly, and in such an awful way, it hurt even more.
Why did he have to die?
She wanted to let him sing one more time.
With nothing but that wish, Sanae made up her mind to perform a secret art passed down in her family.
I didn't get to hear what the secret art was, but I bet that scrap of paper had something to do with it, don't you think?
And the result was...
You already know, don't you?{p}
rows.36:a494:
Yes, I mean the people inside Sanae's mouth.
For generations, Sanae's family has used that secret art to keep their ancestors living inside their bodies as parasites.
All those faces were Sanae's grandfathers and grandmothers.
"Ketsu isn't one of the family, so my body will hurt a bit until he settles in."
Saying that, Sanae finally stopped crying.
I thought I heard a gentle ballad drifting out of her mouth.{p}
rows.36:a630:
...It's really grotesque to look at, though.
Sanae and I are even closer friends than before.
And she seems to have gotten completely better, too.
When she's in a good mood, you can often hear singing.
Who's singing, you ask...? Isn't it obvious?
Whether you believe this story or not is up to you, {c}{f:|}.
Hee hee, well then, that's the end of my story.
Who's next?{p}
rows.36:a7f4:
She was wearing a black cloak and holding one thick book in her hands.
When I looked closer, there was a magic circle drawn in chalk at her feet!
For a second, I hesitated to call out to her.
But Sanae noticed me right away,
"Reiko, what are you doing?
Come over here!"
she called to me, just like that.
She was the same old Sanae.
Her color was completely back to normal, too...
"Watch this. I'm going to summon something amazing."
With that, Sanae turned back to the magic circle and started chanting some weird spell.
"In the name of heaven, earth and the spirits, I command thee, who received life between heaven and earth.
Keeper of the door, swiftly open thy gate and forge the path that leads that one to this land.
The one whose name is Ketsu La Mondo, come forth! Before me!"
It was all so much like a manga.
It really was like something out of a manga or a TV show.{p}
rows.36:aad8:
Suddenly the sky clouded over, and a bolt of lightning came crashing down right into the center of the magic circle.
The whole school building must have shaken.
And then, out of that light...{p}What do you think came out?
rows.36:abb8:
Believe it or not, Ketsu appeared!
But he looked a little different from the Ketsu you see on TV.
He was dressed in a black robe, and his silver hair, in loose waves, rippled all the way down to his feet, and his ears were a bit long and pointed...
And two long horns were growing out of his head!
rows.36:acb4:
Ahh, that look in your eyes! You doubt me, don't you☆
No, you definitely don't believe me.
I won't get mad, so answer honestly.{p}Do you believe my story?
rows.36:ad5c:
Really?
Well, I'll take your word for it.
If you believe me, then you can already guess what kind of person appeared, right?
Hee hee, that's right.
Ketsu the idol star was a demon.
I say demon, but he's just a low-ranking one called an incubus, who seduces girls and takes their souls.
He probably became an idol to make his job easier, don't you think?{p}
rows.36:aeb8:
By the way...
{c}{f:|}, do you know a demon's weakness?
Apparently there are all kinds, but a pretty famous one is the 'true name.'
They say witches and demons must never let anyone learn their true name.
Apparently they lose their magic power if it happens.
Sanae cast a charm so she'd dream about Ketsu, who she loves so much, and in that dream she happened to learn Ketsu's secret.
She always did have a strong sixth sense, after all.
It seems she learned about magic circles from a book she read in the library a while back.{p}
rows.36:b09c:
Still, he's a pretty clumsy demon, isn't he?
I can't forget that grumpy look on his face when he got summoned.
Now he does whatever Sanae tells him.
He's lost all his magic power, but he's still an idol in this world, you know.
...Sanae's so lucky.
{c}{f:|}, this is a huge scoop!
"Top Idol Ketsu's Secret Romance Exposed☆
The Girl: A Beautiful First-Year High Schooler in a Sailor Uniform☆"
How about that?
Ahaha, it's fine.
Sanae doesn't seem to have any intention of hiding it at all.
This is no time to be sitting around!
Hurry and contact a TV station, or a newspaper, anything!
What'll you do?{p}Are you just going to keep the talk going?
rows.36:b2f8:
{f:What should I do|What should I do}...
{f:I|I} hesitated.
{f:But|But} the answer came to me right away.
"Let's continue."
Sure, Fukuzawa's story was juicy.
I {f:think|do think} it's a scoop.
But right now, {f:I|I} have {f:an important job|an important job} to do.
Covering these seven wonders is {f:my|my} first assignment, entrusted to me by Hino{f:.|, after all.}
I can't go chasing scoops before I've even finished a single job.
"Aww, what a letdown.
So the part about believing me was a lie too?
I'm not blaming you or anything.
I just wanted you to interview me too.
But that's so like you, {c}{f:|}.
I thought about pitching it to a TV station or something myself.
But it felt too much like selling out a friend, so I didn't.
Hee hee, sorry.
That was a bit of a sneaky idea, huh?
Well then, I'll end my story about here...
Who's next?"{p}
rows.36:b5f4:
What appeared from the blinding light was the Grim Reaper.
He wore a black cloak and held a huge scythe in his hands.
And under the black hood was a white skull!
...But when everything goes exactly like in the stories up to this point, it kind of makes you laugh, doesn't it?
Of course, I can only say that now...
At the time, I was so shocked I couldn't even make a sound.
But Sanae was different.{p}
rows.36:b7e8:
"Duly received..."
The Reaper's voice was a young man's.
"Human name, Sanae Motoki.
Code name, Ororonna.
You have done well."
"Yes, sir!"
Then he was wrapped in blinding light again, and the Reaper vanished.
With Ketsu's squishy soul wound around his scythe...
When the light faded and the air around us went back to normal, Sanae took off her cloak.{p}
rows.36:b930:
"Phew, that was hot."
That's all she said...
She was the same Sanae as always, not changed one bit.
You'd never think she'd been talking with the Grim Reaper just a moment ago.
"Sanae, what was that just now..."
"So you finally found me out, Reiko. The person just now is called Lord La Mondo, and he's my teacher. That was my very first job. It was the soul of an idol called Ketsu."
Sanae seemed happy to have gotten through her first job safely.
"So you're a Grim Reaper too, Sanae."
"Huh, didn't I tell you?
Sorry, I've been nervous the whole time.
Yeah, that's right.
I'm a Grim Reaper.
Just an apprentice, though."
I had no idea what was what anymore...
A slightly odd girl in my class was actually a Grim Reaper's apprentice, and she used a magic circle to summon the Reaper who was her teacher, and he looked exactly the way you'd expect, and...{p}
rows.36:bbe8: It was all too much, and I think the wires in my brain short-circuited.{p}
rows.36:bc34:
When I came to, I was lying in a bed in the nurse's office.
Maybe it had all been a dream.
That's what I was vaguely thinking.
rows.36:bca4:
Just then, I heard a girl crying in the bed next to mine.
I thought it was Sanae, but it was a girl I didn't know at all.
"Why... why did Ketsu have to die?"
She must have been a Ketsu fan too.
But if Ketsu had really died, then maybe that hadn't been a dream after all...{p}
rows.36:bdd4:
Sanae came to pick me up, and she was just like usual, nothing different about her at all...
She'd probably tell me if I asked, but somehow it's hard to ask.
Besides, I kind of feel like it's fine even if Sanae is a Grim Reaper.
It's not like she goes around killing people.
Apparently Ketsu was sick and pushed himself to go on stage anyway.
It seems it was an illness with no hope of recovery.
So I think dying after the show was just his time.
I wonder if Sanae wears a skull mask like that when she's working, too.{p}
rows.36:bfa0:
That might be kind of cool, actually.
It'd be fun to try believing it, don't you think?
Oops, this was supposed to be a scary story, wasn't it?
Ahaha, sorry.
Anyway, that's as far as my story goes.
I wonder what kind of story the next person has?{p}
rows.36:c078:
You don't believe me, huh.
But I guess that's the normal reaction...
Still, {c}{f:|}, you're the one who's going to write an article based on this.
Maybe you should try believing it a little.
Not that it's my place to say.
Oh well.
A story you can't believe won't make an article anyway, right?
I'll wrap it up quickly.
Next person, go ahead.{p}
rows.36:c1b4:
What's wrong?
I can't tell if you just stay quiet.
Either answer is fine.
Whether you believe it or not is up to you, {c}{f:|}.
Well, if you're unsure, it'd be better to save the rest of this story for another time.
Next time, once you're able to believe it.
Okay then, that's as far as my story goes.
On to the next person.{p}
rows.36:c2f8:
"Everyone, I'm really sorry, but let's continue this another day..."
{f:I|I} rushed through my goodbyes, closed the meeting, and left the club room.{p}
rows.36:c3b8:
I wanted to contact a TV station as soon as possible.
I had the TV station's phone number written down carefully in my notebook.
{f:Ah|Oh}, no!
I'd forgotten my change.
I couldn't find my phone card, either.
At times like this, {f:I'll just|I'll just} borrow the school's equipment!
The closest phone from here is in the night-duty room{f:!|☆}
{f:I|I} headed for the night-duty room.{p}
rows.36:c518:
I nervously peeked into the night-duty room, and the TV had been left on.
{f:But|But} there was no sign of the teacher.
{f:Could the teacher be|Was the teacher} in the restroom?
Anyway, it's now or never{f:!|!}
rows.36:c684:
"Top Idol Ketsu's Secret Romance Exposed☆
The Girl: A Beautiful First-Year High Schooler in a Sailor Uniform☆"
rows.36:c6e0:
{f:I|I} put down the receiver and changed the channel.
"Ketsu Declares His Love☆"
"Engagement Press Conference Tomorrow!"
There were headlines like that too.
DOOOOOOOOOOOM.
{f:I|I} was crushed.
Who knew the Japanese media was this good...
Maybe I should just skip school tomorrow.
How can I ever face Hino, or everyone who went out of their way to gather here{f:?|?}
All I can do is laugh.
{f:Ha|Aha}hahahahahaha...
How empty...{p}
rows.36:c904:
Right in front of us, something like white smoke was floating.
In the middle of the smoke was a woman's face, glaring at us.
"Why couldn't you just leave me alone?
I was finally about to rise up..."
The smoke gradually took on a human shape...
She was wearing the same sailor uniform as us.
"I thought I'd finally been forgiven... and you got in the way. That's too cruel☆"
She seemed incredibly angry.
But even if she said that to me, I didn't know anything about it.
Sanae was the one who summoned her, after all.{p}
rows.36:caf0:
Sanae herself was checking the book and tilting her head.
And then...
"Oh no, I messed up. What do I do...
Ketsu's living spirit was supposed to come out..."
'What do I do' isn't going to cut it, right?
Sanae didn't mean any harm, but she'd called a spirit that was about to ascend to heaven back down to earth.{p}
rows.36:cc18:
"Oh, it's too late now.
I'll be alone here again..."
The woman's spirit looked so sad.
But then, right before our eyes, her face twisted into a horrifying expression!
The spirit let out a shrill shriek and came charging at us, and Sanae and I crouched down right there in terror.
For an instant, something chillingly cold passed right between us.
I was so scared I had my eyes shut then, but Sanae said she saw the whole thing.{p}
rows.36:cdd8:
"She jumped off... crying..."
That voice was what finally made me lift my head.
Sanae was standing at the fence, peering down.
I looked down too, but there was nothing to see there anymore.
"I feel like we did something terrible..."
"Yeah..."{p}
rows.36:ced4:
The two of us just stood there for a while.
But you know, being there gave me a strange feeling.
Pessimistic... I guess you'd call it.
I'm not needed anymore.
Nobody looks at me.
How could I make it all stop hurting... that's what I started to think.
If I climbed over this fence...
Just as I thought that, someone grabbed my arm, and I snapped out of it.{p}
rows.36:d018:
A woman with a bitter, resentful face was clinging to my arm.
That pale face didn't belong to anyone of this world.
When I looked closer, someone else was clinging to that woman's waist, and someone else to that one... lots of spirits, all linked together like a rope.
And all of them were trying to drag me over the fence.{p}
rows.36:d16c:
"Reiko☆"
If Sanae hadn't held on to me, who knows what would have happened...
For a while after that, there was a clear bruise on my arm.
Since then, I've been too scared to go near the roof.
Apparently there was a time when lots of students at this school jumped to their deaths...
I hadn't heard of any lately, but... I wonder if it'll start again.
Sanae's really frightened now, as you'd expect.
I mean, if that happens, it'll be her fault.
She made a spirit angry with black magic she did on a whim.
I'm praying it doesn't come to that...
Huh? What about Ketsu?
I think she's totally over him now.
She can't seem to think about anything else right now.
The only thing I can tell you is, you'd better stay away from the roof.
That's all...
You be careful too, {c}{f:|}.
...Well then, I'll end my story about here.
Whose turn is next...?{p}
